title: Aging Crypto Kitty
tagline: I used erc-6551 to place an Aging Kitty nft into the wallet of a Crypto Kitty
description: The Crypto Kitty I recieved for attending EthPragma was Kahuna Yodelhands.  I used this image to create an animated Gif that is meant to represent it aging.  I minted an Nft  called Aging Kitty.  On tokenbound.org,  i was able to access the erc-6551 smart contract wallet of the original Crypto Kitty.  I transfered the the Aging Kitty nft into the wallet my Kahuna Yodelhands Crypto Kitty.
how_its_made:
The technologies I used are as follows;
-Photoshop for creating the animated Gif.
-Manifold.xyz for the smart contract and minting.
-Tokenbound.org to access the ERC-6551 smart contract wallet of the nft.
-Opensea.io to transfer the Aging Kitty into the Crypto Kitty.

This project would not have been possible without ERC-6551 a new Ethereum standard for token-bound accounts that creates a smart contract for every non-fungible token. A special thanks to Future Primitive for the Crypto Kitty and helping me create my first dynamic Nft.
